design_philosophy.core_principle: Consultative, transparent, friction-free discovery journey for SME business owners. Focus on clarity, education ('Why this matters'), dynamic branching, and real-time visual rewards without score gamification.
design_philosophy.theme_mode: Light mode primary with high contrast typography and crisp warm greys.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500

layout_and_spacing.wizard_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 md:py-10

step_by_step_wizard_architecture.title: Tell us about your business
step_by_step_wizard_architecture.description: Establish your core business identity and industry classification.
fields: Business Name (Text)
Category Cards Selection (Technology & Software, Retail & E-commerce, Professional Services, Healthcare & Wellness, Manufacturing & Goods, Food & Hospitality)
Specific Activity (Text description)
Start Year (Year picker/number)
Location Details (Country, State, City, PIN, Address)
step_by_step_wizard_architecture.reward_card: Business Identity Card (Displays verified badge, entity name, foundation year & location pin)

step_by_step_wizard_architecture.title: Business size & financial scale
step_by_step_wizard_architecture.description: Help us understand your operational scale to gauge risk exposure.
fields: Annual Payroll Band ($0-$250k, $250k-$1M, $1M-$5M, $5M+)
Annual Revenue Band ($0-$500k, $500k-$2M, $2M-$10M, $10M+)
step_by_step_wizard_architecture.reward_card: Live Business Snapshot (Displays headcount scale index, payroll ratio, revenue segment)

step_by_step_wizard_architecture.title: What would be hardest to lose?
step_by_step_wizard_architecture.description: Identify priority assets and operations critical to business survival.
fields: Priority Cards (Multi-select: Key Machinery & Hardware, Customer Data & IP, Revenue Flow & Interruption, Key Personnel / Executives, Physical Premises)
Conditional Follow-ups (e.g. data backup frequency for IP, replacement lead times for equipment)
step_by_step_wizard_architecture.reward_card: Protection Priorities Summary (Highlights top risk vulnerabilities and business resilience priorities)

step_by_step_wizard_architecture.title: Premises and operations
step_by_step_wizard_architecture.description: Map physical footprint, inventory valuation, and customer interaction dynamics.
fields: Premises Ownership (Rented, Owned, Remote / WFH, Hybrid)
Number of Operational Locations
Public & Customer Onsite Visits (Yes / No / Frequent)
Inventory Value Slider / Select
Hazard Elements Checklist (Flammables, Heavy Machinery, Public Access, Hazardous Chemicals)
step_by_step_wizard_architecture.reward_card: Premises & Operations Summary (Displays location footprint, inventory bracket, hazard index)

step_by_step_wizard_architecture.title: Existing insurance coverage
step_by_step_wizard_architecture.description: Review current protection policies and identify immediate coverage gaps.
fields: Current Cover Types (Multi-select: General Liability, Cyber & Data Breach, Commercial Property, Workers Compensation, Directors & Officers, Professional Indemnity)
Policy PDF Upload OR Manual Entry toggle
Claims History (Past 3 years: 0 claims, 1-2 minor claims, major claim)
Ownership Structure (Sole Proprietor, Partnership, LLC / Corp, VC-backed)
step_by_step_wizard_architecture.reward_card: Existing Protection Summary (Visual matrix of active vs missing policy shields)

step_by_step_wizard_architecture.title: Evidence & documentation (Optional)
step_by_step_wizard_architecture.description: Attach optional media and documents to accelerate underwriting and policy verification.
fields: Premises Walkthrough (Video/Photos Upload dropzone)
Machinery & Asset Photos (Photo Upload dropzone)
Policy PDF Upload (File dropzone with status: Uploaded / Pending / Skipped)
step_by_step_wizard_architecture.reward_card: Evidence & Verification Vault (Displays uploaded asset inventory list & verification statuses)

step_by_step_wizard_architecture.title: Business protection summary
step_by_step_wizard_architecture.description: Comprehensive diagnostic overview, itemized status audit, and next action recommendations.
fields: Business at a Glance summary card
What May Need a Closer Look (Categorized items with 4 distinct status badges: Known [Green], Needs Verification [Amber], Potential Limitation [Indigo], Potential Gap [Amber/Red])
What to do Next actionable roadmap steps
Inline edit buttons for any step section
Downloadable Summary (PDF / JSON download trigger)
Shareable summary link generator modal

ux_feature_requirements.progress_navigation: Top fixed stepper with step progress percentage bar, clickable step numbers for completed steps, Back and Next buttons with keyboard support.
ux_feature_requirements.live_summary_sidebar: Sticky responsive side panel showing real-time business identity & unlocked reward cards as the user completes steps. Supports collapse/expand toggle on mobile.
ux_feature_requirements.explainers: Every complex question has a 'Why this matters' expandable accordion banner with light blue accent background (#EFF6FF) and icon.
ux_feature_requirements.uncertainty_toggles: Provide 'Not sure', 'Estimate only', or 'I'll do this later' radio/checkbox options for financial, inventory, and policy fields to prevent drop-off.
ux_feature_requirements.no_gamified_scores: Strictly NO points, badges like 'Level 5 Risk', or arbitrary 0-100 credit scores. Use professional status indicators: Known, Needs verification, Potential limitation, Potential gap.
ux_feature_requirements.downloadable_summary: Generate formatted client-side summary printable layout with option to download as JSON/PDF preview.

image_urls.alt: Modern SME Team Working in Office

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case role-based test identifiers (e.g. data-testid='step-1-next-button', data-testid='business-name-input', data-testid='summary-download-pdf-button', data-testid='live-summary-sidebar')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: WCAG AA compliant (minimum 4.5:1 text contrast). Explicit dark slate text over light slate backgrounds.
testing_and_accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full tab ordering, explicit focus ring styles (ring-2 ring-blue-500 ring-offset-2).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete 7-step wizard journey inside React using standard component modularization (e.g. components/wizard/Step1Identity.jsx, Step2Size.jsx, Step3Priorities.jsx, Step4Premises.jsx, Step5Insurance.jsx, Step6Evidence.jsx, Step7Summary.jsx).
Implement the live business summary sidebar component that reacts instantly to state changes across all steps.
Include 'Why this matters' expandable tooltips/banners for every major section.
Provide 'Not sure / Estimate only' switches for numerical inputs.
Use Lucide-React icons for step icons, status badges, and asset visualizers.
Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, card select, and status indicator includes explicit data-testid attributes.
Strictly avoid any dark-gradient slop; keep backgrounds clean white (#FFFFFF) and light grey (#F8FAFC) with vibrant restrained blue (#2563EB) actions and warm amber (#D97706) highlights.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow generous spacing (p-6, p-8), light theme priority, clear hierarchy, no centered body text, explicit hover/focus state text contrast, and no generic text-8xl/9xl headings.
